extractor_notes: The held counts match all four served slots. Counts are subjects_affected, not episodes; denominators are subjects_at_risk, with no explicit randomised/analysed/safety-treated classification. The short count spans are linked to arm titles through their enclosing reported_events records: 91/1550 has result_group_id 837686409 and EG001, matching Alirocumab 150 mg Q2W; 33/788 has result_group_id 837686408 and EG000, matching Placebo Q2W. The JSON separates arm identifiers from counts by the long time_frame field, so no contiguous span under 300 characters includes both. The abstract reports injection-site reactions (5.9% vs. 4.2%) for alirocumab versus placebo, and 2341 randomised patients overall without numeric per-arm randomised totals. Adverse-event collection continued through the Week 86 post-treatment follow-up visit; reported events use the treatment-emergent window quoted above.
